pr_title: Fix fritzbox_callmonitor sensor state so concurrent calls are handled correctly
pr_body:

Fritzbox callmonitor now sets state properly even with concurrent calls. Before, state reverted to idle after any disconnect, even if another call was still ongoing.

issue_context.title: Fritzbox Callmonitor sets wrong state with incoming call during ongoing call
issue_context.body:
When a new incoming call is received while another call is ongoing, the sensor state changes from talking to ringing. When the second caller then hangs up (because no one picked up this second call) the state changes to idle, even though the original call is still ongoing and the correct change would be from ringing back to talking.

The sequence that the fritzbox reports on port 1012 during such an event is the following (comments mine, numbers replaced):

```
11.07.20 19:00:42;RING;0;<first caller number>;<fritzbox number>;SIP0;   # first call incoming
11.07.20 19:00:44;CONNECT;0;10;<first caller number>;  # first call pickup and ongoing
11.07.20 19:00:50;RING;2;<second caller number>;<fritzbox number>;SIP0;  # second call incoming, not picked up
11.07.20 19:00:54;DISCONNECT;2;0;  # second caller hangs up
11.07.20 19:01:11;DISCONNECT;0;24;  # first call ended
```
